environment.cache: warm SQLite/OS caches after isolated seed; one five-request warmup round per category excluded

method.p95: nearest-rank ceil(0.95*N) over separate repeated endpoint samples
method.spans: policy includes snapshots; sums are cumulative observed service time and are not additive wall time
method.client: five simultaneous threads; response JSON validation occurs after each round

boundaries: Synthetic real HTTP API measurements on fresh isolated data. Not browser first usable content, real-source coverage, large full text, cold storage, or seven-day acceptance.
